title: nf-nomad manuscript assets
description:
Reproducible infrastructure templates, validation configurations, measured results and a reviewer protocol for nf-nomad, the Nextflow executor plugin for HashiCorp Nomad. Includes a containerised multi-node deployment that runs on a single machine, a preemptible Google Cloud deployment, per-mode Nextflow configurations (shared POSIX filesystem, Fusion, nf-nomad-s5cmd), a preemption-resilience harness, and the datasets behind the results the manuscript reports.

Companion artefact to the nf-nomad manuscript.
